item.title: Meta has removed just 250,000 Facebook and Instagram accounts since the social media ban began
item.summary: Since the start of the Under 16 social media ban in Australia in December, Meta has only removed around 250,000 accounts across Facebook and Instagram which were believed to be held by under-age users.
